paragraphs.notes: Continuation of the substituent-definition list that runs across the preceding and following pages; the page opens and closes mid-sentence, so there is no sentence boundary at either edge and no paragraph marker (this patent numbers no paragraphs). The list as printed omits Cycloalkenylsulfonylamino between Cycloalkylalkinylsulfonylamino and Cycloalkenylalkylsulfonylamino, and omits Alkylamino / Heterocyclylamino before Heterocyclylalkylamino; both gaps are transcribed as printed and not filled in. German 'Alkinyl' is rendered 'alkynyl' in the English. Line-final hyphens in 'N-Alkyl-N-' are part of the chemical name, not line-break hyphenation, so the lines are joined without a space there.
